title: TASTE: Task-Aware Out-of-Distribution Detection via Stein Operators
abstract: arXiv:2602.07640v2 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: Out-of-distribution detection methods are often either data-centric, detecting deviations from the training input distribution irrespective of their effect on a trained model, or model-centric, relying on classifier outputs without explicit reference to data geometry. We propose TASTE (Task-Aware STEin operators): a task-aware framework based on so-called Stein operators, which links distribution shift to the input sensitivity of the model. The resulting operators admit a geometric interpretation as a projection of distribution shift onto the sensitivity field of the model, with theoretical guarantees. Beyond detecting a shift, the construction enables its localisation through a coordinate-wise decomposition, and - for image data - provides interpretable per-pixel diagnostics. translated_abstract: 分布外检测方法通常要么以数据为中心，即检测与训练输入分布的偏差而不考虑其对训练后模型的影响；要么以模型为中心，即依赖分类器的输出而不显式参考数据的几何结构。我们提出了TASTE（任务感知Stein算子）：一个基于所谓Stein算子的任务感知框架，它将分布偏移与模型的输入敏感度联系起来。由此得到的算子具有几何解释——将分布偏移投影到模型的敏感度场上，并具有理论保证。除了检测偏移之外，该构造还能通过逐坐标分解实现偏移的定位，并且对于图像数据，还能提供可解释的逐像素诊断。在受控高斯偏移、几何扰动下的MNIST以及CIFAR-10/ImageNet-1K扰动基准上的实验表明，TASTE与（摘要在此处截断）
tldr: 提出基于Stein算子的任务感知分布外检测框架TASTE，将分布偏移解释为向模型敏感度场的投影，不仅能检测偏移还能通过逐坐标分解和逐像素诊断实现偏移的定位。
en_tdlr: TASTE is a task-aware out-of-distribution detection framework based on Stein operators, which interprets distribution shifts as projections onto the model's sensitivity field, enabling both shift detection and localization through coordinate-wise decomposition and interpretable per-pixel diagnostics for image data.
